summary: Iteration 5 — Backend 7/7 PASS against live https://utility-contract-hub.emergent.host (forgot-password 200 for known+unknown emails, reset-password with bogus token returns 4xx gracefully, /register creates account + returns {token,user}, /me authenticated echoes new email, /quotes/multi with electric+water returns {quote_request_id}, /news returns {news:[...]}). Frontend (Expo web preview @ 390x844, base https://wide-doc-signing.preview.emergentagent.com): (1) Forgot password: signin-forgot-link → forgot-header; invalid email inline error; submit valid → forgot-sent; forgot-have-code → reset-header; forgot-back-signin verified in code. (2) Reset password: short pw + mismatched confirm show inline errors (both); submitting reset-submit with token='bogus' stays on page and shows graceful toast (no crash). (3) Sign-Up wizard: signin-signup-link → signup-header 'Step 1 of 2'; empty step1 shows inline validation; unique email e2e_signup_1786967441@example.com + Password123!, Step 2 chips (limited_company/sole_trader/partnership/charity) tap-selectable, signup-submit → /dashboard authenticated. (4) Quote wizard: quote-header 'Step 1 of 2', empty selection blocked ('Pick at least one utility'), Electricity+Water tiles toggle orange, water reveals quote-water-supplier and blocks Next until filled, meter fields optional, Step 2 loads, submit → quote-success-title (real quote_request_id created). (5) Industry news: profile-news-link → news-header, news-card-0 rendered (live public feed). (6) Regression: bottom tabs work, signout returns to signin. Networking: 15/15 /api/* requests during the E2E run went to https://utility-contract-hub.emergent.host (zero leaks). ONE BUG FOUND: quote/new does NOT prefill quote-contact-name and quote-contact-email from the authenticated user even when useAuth().user is fully hydrated (verified with the existing test account after signing in; both fields were empty). RCA: /app/frontend/app/quote/new.tsx lines 50-51 seed local state via useState(user?.full_name…) only ONCE at mount; there is no useEffect syncing when the AuthProvider finishes hydrating, so the fields stay blank. Spec explicitly requires prefill.

ui_bugs.issue: quote-contact-name and quote-contact-email are NOT prefilled from the authenticated user (spec says they must be). useState initializer captures user before AuthProvider hydration completes and never re-syncs.

action_items: FIX (HIGH): /app/frontend/app/quote/new.tsx — add a useEffect that syncs local name/email state whenever `user` changes from AuthProvider, so quote-contact-name/quote-contact-email prefill correctly after auth hydration. Example: useEffect(() => { if (!name && (user?.full_name || user?.company_name)) setName(user.full_name || user.company_name || ''); if (!email && user?.email) setEmail(user.email); }, [user]);
OPTIONAL carry-over: migrate shadow.card in /app/frontend/src/theme/theme.ts to boxShadow to silence the RN-web deprecation warning.

context_for_next_testing_agent: All four new screens (forgot-password, reset-password, signup, quote/new, news) are wired to the live backend correctly. The only defect is that quote-contact-name and quote-contact-email fail to prefill from useAuth().user because /app/frontend/app/quote/new.tsx uses useState lazy initializers without a follow-up useEffect. Fix by syncing on user change. Backend tests are idempotent and safe to re-run.
rca_of_issue: Bug: quote contact fields not prefilled. Reproduction: sign in as any existing user with a full_name+email, navigate to /quote/new, complete step 1, land on step 2 — quote-contact-name and quote-contact-email are BLANK. Root cause: /app/frontend/app/quote/new.tsx lines 50-51 use `useState(user?.full_name || user?.company_name || '')` and `useState(user?.email || '')`, which only capture the value ONCE at first render. AuthProvider hydrates asynchronously from SecureStore, so on the first render the `user` context can be null and the local state is locked to empty. Mitigation: add `useEffect(() => { if (user) { setName(prev => prev || user.full_name || user.company_name || ''); setEmail(prev => prev || user.email || ''); } }, [user]);`.
